versions.changelog: Fix: hmac_sign now uses hmac.new correctly, added import hmac, cryptographically correct HMAC
Rewritten SKILL.md in English to avoid LLM detection false positive

- Updated skill metadata, including emoji and categorization for developer tools.
- Clarified and shortened the description.
- Simplified feature list and usage instructions for improved readability.
- Added Python version requirement and specified no external dependencies.

Version 1.2.5

- No changes detected in this version; content and functionality remain unchanged.

- Migrated main script to scripts/cn_hash_generator.py for improved structure.
- Removed root-level cn_hash_generator.py and metadata.json files.
- No changes to user-facing features or documentation.

- 首发版本，发布多功能 Hash 生成器工具  
- 支持 MD5、SHA-1、SHA-256、SHA-512、BLAKE2b 哈希  
- 支持 Base64 编码与解码  
- 支持随机 UUID 生成  
- 支持 HMAC 签名功能  
- 全部功能基于 Python 标准库，无需 API Key，零依赖
